from numpy.polynomial import legendre as L

def pb(x,d): return np.column_stack([L.legval(x,np.eye(d+1)[i]) for i in range(d+1)])
for dt,dA in [(3,3),(5,5),(7,7),(9,9)]:
    B=np.column_stack([pb(tn,dt)[:,i]*pb(An,dA)[:,j] for i in range(dt+1) for j in range(dA+1)])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dA_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    print('full tensor',dt,dA, np.mean((B@c-dA_dt)**2)/np.var(dA_dt), B.shape[1])
# rank-r separable ALS
Pt=pb(tn,8); PA=pb(An,8)
def rankr(r,it=300):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
    a=rng.normal(size=(9,r)); b=rng.normal(size=(9,r))
    for _ in range(it):
        # fit g(t) given h(A)
        Z=np.column_stack([ (PA@b)[:,k:k+1]*Pt for k in range(r)])
        ca=np.linalg.lstsq(Z,dA_dt,rcond=None)[0]
        a=ca.reshape(r,9).T
        Z2=np.column_stack([ (Pt@a)[:,k:k+1]*PA for k in range(r)])
        cb=np.linalg.lstsq(Z2,dA_dt,rcond=None)[0]
        b=cb.reshape(r,9).T
    pred=sum((Pt@a)[:,k]*(PA@b)[:,k] for k in range(r))
    return np.mean((pred-dA_dt)**2)/np.var(dA_dt)
for r in [1,2,3,4]: print('rank',r,rankr(r))
